topography.project_purpose: Farm. Structurally: 68 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 8 ERC20 tokens, 3 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 17 common project-authored base contract(s) (whitelist, ownable2step, sybase). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
